summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for CamelAI-specific AgentOps integration setup. It differs semantically from peer candidates (Mistral, SwarmZero) by targeting a different SDK ecosystem, and differs from existing skills (OpenTelemetry APM, Spring Security migration) by asset_type, domain, task_family, and objective. No existing skill covers CamelAI agent tracking. Peer candidates represent parallel SDK integrations, not overlaps. Support evidence is present and non-conflicting.
